description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering search parameters related to employee dependents within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base filter parameter class and includes properties for employee number, dependent name, and relationship type, along with associated setters and getters.

classes.name: EmployeeDependentSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for encapsulating filter parameters used when searching for employee dependents, including sorting options and filter criteria such as name, employee number, and relationship type.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the sort field to 'd.name'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter parameter.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter parameter.

methods.name: getRelationshipType
methods.description: Returns the relationship type filter parameter.

methods.name: setRelationshipType
methods.description: Sets the relationship type filter parameter.
